newsitem.title: USA: Burlington Northern expects lower Q1 EPS.
newsitem.headline: Burlington Northern expects lower Q1 EPS.

text.p: Burlington Northern Santa Fe Corp said Wednesday it expected its earnings per share for the first quarter to be about 20 percent below the $1.21 reported for the same period last year.

As previously announced, the company said its operations were set back by winter storms, blizzards and mud slides across northern rail lines, from Minnesota to Washington and Oregon, between December and earlier this month.
Burlington Northern said it expects second quarter results to show significant improvement over the first quarter as it overcomes the effects of the winter weather.
